headline: IMF Reportedly Urges Kenya to Widen Tax Base Rather Than Raise Rates
summary: Reports indicate the International Monetary Fund has urged Kenya to broaden its tax base instead of increasing tax rates, ahead of talks scheduled for December.
why: Fiscal policy adjustments and IMF program conditions strongly influence sovereign debt yields, currency stability, and economic growth in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: The reported IMF recommendation directly targets Kenya's national tax structure and fiscal policy.
